notes:
Elementor is a WordPress page-builder PLUGIN, not a hosting platform; sites run on the owner's own domain and serve ALL Elementor assets same-origin under /wp-content/plugins/elementor(-pro)/ and per-page CSS under /wp-content/uploads/elementor/. There is no front-end asset CDN, so cdnDomains is empty (mirror by rewriting the site's own /wp-content/ paths). Only default hosting subdomain is *.elementor.cloud (Elementor Cloud/Hosting product) which still serves WordPress assets same-origin — NOT independently fetched this session, medium confidence, retained from docs.

DETECTION (verified priority): (1) Scan EVERY meta[name=generator] content for /^Elementor\s+\d+\.\d+/ — this is the single most reliable marker; do NOT assume it is the first generator tag. (2) Fallback when generator is stripped by optimization plugins: body-class /\belementor-kit-\d+\b/ together with /\belementor-page\b/, plus root div class 'elementor elementor-{id}' with data-elementor-type/data-elementor-id/data-elementor-post-type. (3) Asset presence of /wp-content/plugins/elementor/assets/. (4) Universal element marker 'elementor-element elementor-element-{hash}' with data-element_type. Flexbox-container classes (e-con/e-parent) only appear on 3.6+ container-based sites, so treat them as corroborating not required.

RENDER: fully server-rendered PHP/WordPress; full DOM present in raw HTML, so ssr-static, no hydration wait. Pro widgets bootstrap from inline window.elementorFrontendConfig/ElementorProFrontendConfig but core content is JS-independent.
